archetypes.name: dyn-rebase-routing
archetypes.rationale: CHECKPOINT_NEXT changes macro routing across Python and prompt contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed rebase checkpoint contract end to end. Verify that successful probes emit and relay CHECKPOINT_NEXT=continue, failure/conflict probes emit load-routing, and degraded Step 1.r paths do not synthesize a rebase failure. Check that ROUTE and REBASE details remain available only after the macro loads the routing reference. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-skill-contract
archetypes.rationale: Skill prose now defines the orchestrator routing boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on skills/implement/SKILL.md and rebase-checkpoint-routing.md. Confirm the four call sites use CHECKPOINT_NEXT as the only macro skip predicate and that Step 7a no longer implies wrapper exit code drives macro routing. Look for contradictory residual prose that could confuse an orchestrator. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
